title: Make a zero-duration widget publication cancel an active older transition
description:
At audited582e, publish gauge level0, then level1 with200ms; render at0 and advance the injected clock100ms so the visible value is about0.5. Publish level0 with transition_ms0 and render without advancing time. Expected: immediately draw0, cancel that instance animation, and stop widget-only wake/raster work. Current source: sync_widget_textures starts/replaces an animation only for positive duration, then resolve_animated_params reads the old animation.to_params and upload_texture preserves it. Predicted visible value remains about0.5 and the old1 target continues. This exact scenario has not been executed by the audit. Public gRPC supplies transition_ms and MCP supplies0, so a MCP update can hit the same compositor path after a gRPC transition. Repair only this instant-retarget behavior and the trustworthiness of its existing fixture.

Authority: full parent5/.5.1 original contract, docs/api.md transition semantics, docs/invariants.md6/9 and docs/vision.md cheap idle. Qualified owner: tze_hud_compositor::Compositor::sync_widget_textures (renderer/widgets.rs124-147) -> widget::WidgetRenderer::resolve_animated_params (widget.rs2711-2749), existing WidgetTextureEntry.animation and upload_texture preservation (2957). SceneGraph::publish_to_widget_for_lease (zone_ops.rs482) validates/coerces and stores transition_ms559; protocol::session_server::verbs::publish_widget625 passes it, MCP::tools widget publish566 passes0. Both compositor frame paths sync the same renderer; windowed real render/wake readers consume has_inflight_animation and next_animation_deadline. Cancel the existing instance animation for an authoritative zero-duration publication before resolving effective params, including the case the old animation target equals the new instant target. Preserve continuous positive-duration retargeting, first appearance, color/f32 interpolation, string/enum snapping, Simplified snapping, injected rewind behavior, per-instance raster counters and current clear/TTL cleanup. Do not add a publication clock, schema or state framework. Extend the existing retarget_mid_flight_is_continuous_and_uses_the_new_duration fixture after its400ms case to cover0 both changed-target and same-old-target cases, checking actual last rasterized values, no active transition/deadline, and unchanged raster count on a later injected tick. Keep all existing8 cases. Rig::new currently silently returns None for NoAdapter or SKIP_GPU. Under REQUIRE_GPU1, make that existing setup fail closed (retain explicit permitted optional skip behavior outside required proof) so this same gate cannot report a passing early return. PR1296/.1.8 fixed mutex/ICD only and is not an equivalent behavior or fail-closed repair. No new attributed test.
